addresses.description: Default I2C address when ADDR pin connected to logic low
Alternate I2C address when ADDR pin connected to logic high

read_channels.notes: 16-bit raw temperature value from sensor output
16-bit raw humidity value from sensor output

access_model.notes: Commands are 16-bit; after measurement command, read data directly with I2C read header.

transaction.notes: Send START, I2C write header (device address + write bit), then 16-bit command 0x2400 (MSB 0x24, LSB 0x00) for high repeatability, no clock stretching.

steps.notes: Send single shot measurement command with high repeatability and clock stretching disabled.
Wait at least measurement duration (max 15 ms for high repeatability) before reading data.

transaction.notes: Send START, I2C read header (device address + read bit). Read 2 bytes temperature, 1 byte CRC, 2 bytes humidity, 1 byte CRC.

steps.notes: Read temperature and humidity data with CRC checksums.

outputs.notes: First two data bytes are temperature MSB and LSB.
After temperature CRC, next two bytes are humidity MSB and LSB.

operation_flows.notes: Single shot measurement with high repeatability, no clock stretching. Data is read after waiting for measurement completion.

transaction.notes: Send START, I2C write header, then 16-bit command 0x2C06 (MSB 0x2C, LSB 0x06) for high repeatability, clock stretching enabled.

steps.notes: Send single shot measurement command with clock stretching enabled.
Sensor pulls SCL low until measurement complete. Max measurement duration 15 ms.

transaction.notes: Send START, I2C read header. Read 2 bytes temperature, 1 byte CRC, 2 bytes humidity, 1 byte CRC.

steps.notes: Read measurement data after clock stretching ends.

operation_flows.notes: Single shot measurement with clock stretching; sensor holds SCL low until data ready.

transaction.notes: Send START, I2C write header, then 16-bit command 0x2130 for 1 mps, high repeatability (example from datasheet).

steps.notes: Start periodic data acquisition with specified repeatability and mps. Example uses 1 mps high repeatability.

operation_flows.notes: After this command, sensor continuously acquires data. Use fetch_data_periodic to read results.

transaction.notes: Send START, I2C write header, then 16-bit fetch data command (0xE000).

steps.notes: Fetch data command to retrieve latest measurement.

transaction.notes: Send START, I2C read header. Read 2 bytes temperature, 1 byte CRC, 2 bytes humidity, 1 byte CRC.

steps.notes: Read temperature and humidity data.

operation_flows.notes: Fetch data command clears data memory after read.

transaction.notes: Send START, I2C write header, then 16-bit break command (0x3093).

steps.notes: Break command to stop periodic acquisition and enter single shot mode.
Wait 1 ms for sensor to abort measurement and enter single shot mode.

transaction.notes: Send START, I2C write header, then 16-bit soft reset command (0x30A2).

steps.notes: Soft reset command.
Wait soft reset time t_SR (max 1.5 ms) for sensor to enter idle state.

operation_flows.notes: Soft reset forces system into well-defined state without removing power.

preconditions: Sensor able to process I2C commands

transaction.notes: Send START, general call address 0x00 (write), then second byte 0x06, then STOP.

steps.notes: Reset via general call address. Affects all devices on bus that support general call.
Wait for reset to complete; soft reset time t_SR (max 1.5 ms) is assumed similar.

operation_flows.notes: General call reset is functionally identical to nReset pin reset.

transaction.notes: Send START, I2C write header, then 16-bit heater enable command (0x306D).

steps.notes: Enable heater.

operation_flows.notes: Heater is meant for plausibility checking only.

transaction.notes: Send START, I2C write header, then 16-bit heater disable command (0x3066).

steps.notes: Disable heater.

operation_flows.notes: Heater disabled by default after reset.

transaction.notes: Send START, I2C write header, then 16-bit command to read status register (0xF32D).

steps.notes: Command to read status register.

transaction.notes: Send START, I2C read header. Read 2 bytes status register, 1 byte CRC.

steps.notes: Read status register value.

operation_flows.notes: Status register contains heater, alert, and command execution status.

transaction.notes: Send START, I2C write header, then 16-bit command to clear status register (0x3041).

steps.notes: Clear status register flags.
While leaving SDA high, toggle SCL nine or more times.
Follow with a Transmission Start sequence (START condition) before next command.

operation_flows.notes: Resets serial interface only; status register preserves content.

registers_or_commands.name: Status Register
registers_or_commands.description: Contains information on operational status of heater, alert mode, execution status of last command and last write sequence.

bitfields.name: Alert pending status
bitfields.description: '0': no pending alerts, '1': at least one pending alert

bitfields.name: System reset detected
bitfields.description: '0': no reset detected since last 'clear status register' command, '1': reset detected (hard reset, soft reset command or supply fail)

bitfields.name: Command status
bitfields.description: '0': last command executed successfully, '1': last command not processed (invalid or failed checksum)

bitfields.name: Write data checksum status
bitfields.description: '0': checksum of last write transfer was correct, '1': checksum of last write transfer failed

init_sequence.notes: Power-up: after VDD reaches V_POR, wait t_PU (max 1 ms) for sensor to enter idle state.
Optionally perform soft reset (0x30A2) to ensure known state.

read_sequence.notes: Use single shot measurement flow: send command, wait, read data.

timing_constraints.name: power_up_time
timing_constraints.notes: Time between VDD reaching V_POR and sensor entering idle state.

timing_constraints.name: soft_reset_time
timing_constraints.notes: Time between ACK of soft reset command and sensor entering idle state.

timing_constraints.name: minimal_waiting_time_after_command
timing_constraints.condition: After sending a command to the sensor
timing_constraints.notes: Minimal waiting time before another command can be received.

error_conditions.condition: CRC checksum mismatch on read data
error_conditions.detection: CRC-8 (polynomial 0x31, init 0xFF) computed over two data bytes does not match received CRC byte.
error_conditions.driver_action: Discard data and retry read; if persistent, return -EIO.

error_conditions.detection: Sensor responds with NACK to read header (e.g., no data ready in periodic mode).
error_conditions.driver_action: Retry after waiting measurement duration; if persistent, return -EAGAIN.

error_conditions.detection: Status register bit 1 is '1' after command.

error_conditions.condition: Write data checksum status bit set
error_conditions.detection: Status register bit 0 is '1' after write.
error_conditions.driver_action: Re-send write with correct checksum; if persistent, return -EIO.

power_states.name: idle
power_states.description: Sensor not performing measurement or communication. Automatically entered after power-up or after measurement.

power_states.name: measuring
power_states.description: Sensor performing measurement. Current consumption up to 1500 µA.

evidence_spans.snippet: I2C address A: 0x44 (default) ADDR (pin 2) connected to logic low
I2C address B: 0x45 ADDR (pin 2) connected to logic high
e.g. 0x2130: 1 high repeatability mps - measurement per second
Reset command using the general call address: 0x0006
Command to read out the status register: 0xF32D
Command to clear the status register: 0x3041
Measurement duration high repeatability: max 15 ms
CRC-8, polynomial 0x31, initialization 0xFF, reflect input false, reflect output false, final XOR 0x00

requires_human: The exact 16-bit command codes for read status register, clear status register, fetch data, break, and soft reset are not explicitly given in the provided snippets; they need to be confirmed from full datasheet.
The CRC polynomial is 0x31, initialization 0xFF, but the exact implementation details (reflect input/output, final XOR) are provided; however, the checksum algorithm must be implemented correctly.
The periodic mode commands (Table 10) have many combinations; the user must select appropriate repeatability and mps.
The ART command (0x2B32) is mentioned but not fully detailed in the snippets; its behavior and usage need human verification.
General call reset wait time: datasheet does not specify a wait time after general call reset; soft reset time (1.5 ms) is assumed but may differ.
